_readme: THE ROADSHOW — config for booking Matthew anywhere on Earth.
Two home bases, one active at a time. The active flag is the fallback
for the Worker's KV value (key: base) — flip it there from the desk, or
here with a commit. 'Last logged in' wiring: the desk login handler
POSTs /api/travel/base so the flag follows Matthew automatically once
Policy: travel bills at cost, itemized, no markup hidden in the fee.
Flights are live quotes (Duffel). Rooms are Hilton-family properties
only — never a motel. Ground is estimated per-mile/per-minute and
labeled an estimate. Local jobs (within local_radius_mi of the active
base) bill ground only: the ride to the venue and back, both ways.
